acceptance_gates.metric: Validated control operation across the full 20 to 55 m/s envelope
acceptance_gates.name: operating_range_coverage
acceptance_gates.threshold: 100 percent of test points within range must complete without unhandled fault

acceptance_gates.metric: Worst-case application error relative to the defined reference metric
acceptance_gates.name: maximum_error
acceptance_gates.threshold: Less than or equal to 3.0 percent

acceptance_gates.metric: Rate of stale commands rejected during injected stale-input tests
acceptance_gates.name: stale_command_rejection
acceptance_gates.threshold: 100 percent rejection of injected stale commands

acceptance_gates.metric: Actuator commands exceeding configured bounds during validation
acceptance_gates.name: command_bounding

acceptance_gates.metric: Time from timeout detection to safe fallback activation
acceptance_gates.name: timeout_to_safe_fallback
acceptance_gates.threshold: Measurable and within a defined system limit verified in test; limit shall be specified by implementation

acceptance_gates.metric: Fallback activation rate under fault-injection scenarios requiring safe mode
acceptance_gates.name: safe_fallback_activation

acceptance_gates.metric: Traceability from inputs to outputs through the reference workflow
acceptance_gates.name: deterministic_reference_traceability
acceptance_gates.threshold: Complete traceability demonstrated for all validation runs

constraints: Operating range limited to stream velocities from 20 to 55 m/s.
Control outputs must be bounded and clamped to allowable actuator limits.
Stale model commands must be rejected.
Timeout conditions must transition to a defined safe state.
A safe fallback mode must be available whenever command validity is uncertain.
The solution must remain transparent and referenceable, with a clearly defined baseline implementation.
Application accuracy must not exceed 3.0 percent maximum error relative to the defined reference metric.
The system must support the supplied geometry format and reference geometry source.
No assumption may be made that pretrained inference is already available.
Technology selection is not fixed by this contract; implementation may vary as long as requirements are met.

interfaces.description: Accepts geometry files and associated metadata for the reference aerodynamic shape.
interfaces.name: geometry_input

interfaces.description: Accepts stream velocity and any required run-time environmental parameters.
interfaces.name: operating_condition_input

interfaces.description: Provides validated state and configuration data to the surrogate evaluation workflow.
interfaces.name: surrogate_model_input

interfaces.description: Emits bounded active-aerodynamics commands for downstream actuator use.
interfaces.name: control_command_output

interfaces.description: Reports command validity, freshness, timeout status, and fallback state.
interfaces.name: status_and_fault_output

interfaces.description: Provides reference-path results for comparison against the operational workflow.
interfaces.name: reference_result_output

name: intelligent_active_aerodynamics_controller
objective: Develop a transparent, bounded active-aerodynamics control product for automotive airflow over the specified velocity range using a physics-based surrogate workflow, with explicit system partitioning, architecture optimization, and integrated safety handling including stale-data rejection, timeout handling, command clamping, and safe fallback behavior.
required_capabilities: Ingest geometry and operating-condition inputs for automotive aerodynamic evaluation.
Evaluate a physics-based surrogate model for active-aerodynamics decision support.
Provide a transparent reference path for comparison and validation.
Partition the application into data ingestion, model evaluation, control decision, safety supervision, and actuator command generation functions.
Detect stale inputs or stale model outputs using age, sequence, or timestamp validity checks.
Monitor for timeouts and missing updates.
Transition to a safe fallback command set on fault, timeout, or invalid data.
Support implementation on a resource-constrained embedded control platform with deterministic behavior requirements.
Expose runtime status and fault state for integration and verification.
Allow architecture optimization against latency, memory, and resource limits.

workloads.description: Load the supplied geometry representation, verify format validity, and prepare the aerodynamic model input set.
workloads.name: geometry_ingestion_and_validation

workloads.description: Evaluate control behavior at discrete and continuous stream velocities across the specified envelope.
workloads.name: operating_point_evaluation

workloads.description: Execute the selected physics-based surrogate workflow to estimate aerodynamic response under changing conditions.
workloads.name: physics_based_surrogate_execution

workloads.description: Run a clearly defined reference path for comparison, calibration, and validation against the surrogate-driven outputs.
workloads.name: transparent_reference_execution

workloads.description: Decompose the application into data handling, model execution, control logic, supervision, and command output functions, then integrate them into a single product flow.
workloads.name: system_partitioning_and_integration

workloads.description: Continuously inspect input freshness, command validity, and timing behavior, and issue safe fallback actions when violations occur.
workloads.name: safety_monitoring_and_fault_response

workloads.description: Iterate implementation parameters to satisfy latency, memory, and determinism goals while preserving the required control behavior.
workloads.name: architecture_optimization

workloads.description: Execute measurable tests covering accuracy, stale-data rejection, command bounding, timeout handling, and safe fallback activation.
workloads.name: validation_and_acceptance_testing
